title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty defend the 23,000 support zone?
description: Nifty enters the week in a corrective, range-bound setup, with 23,000–23,100 emerging as crucial support and 23,500 as the first resistance. Weak momentum indicators and subdued volatility suggest cautious trading. A sustained move above 23,500 could support a rebound, while a break below 23,000 may deepen the correction.

He expects policy announcements and stronger business numbers to ease concerns around NIMs and FCNR flows, while capital goods, banking and metals could deliver stronger earnings momentum.

title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Ethereum nears $2,620 despite hawkish Fed, CLARITY Act setback
description: Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000 and Ethereum approached $2,620 as crypto markets recovered despite a hawkish Federal Reserve stance and uncertainty around the CLARITY Act. Improving risk sentiment, cooling oil prices and short liquidations supported the rebound, while ETF outflows, elevated rates and regulatory uncertainty remain key factors shaping the market outlook.

title: Warren Buffett sounds alarm as stock market warning returns for only second time in 155 years
description: Warren Buffett’s caution comes as the S&P 500’s CAPE ratio approaches levels seen only during periods of extreme valuations. While elevated readings can signal weaker long-term returns, they do not predict near-term crashes. Buffett’s investment philosophy instead emphasises economic moats, durable cash flows and businesses capable of compounding across market cycles.

title: F&O Talk: 23,050 key Nifty support; Sudeep Shah outlines Tata stocks strategy, names 5 picks

SBI Securities’ Sudeep Shah outlines the outlook for Nifty, Bank Nifty and IT, shares technical views on Tata stocks, and names five stocks that look promising for the coming week.

title: Crude Oil Above $100: Can Saudi Arabia’s export disruption trigger a new global energy shock?
description: Crude oil has crossed $100 a barrel as Saudi Arabia faces disruptions to its alternative export route following attacks on the East-West Pipeline. Prolonged outages could tighten global supplies, raise prices and increase risks for oil-importing economies such as India, while a sustained disruption could push Brent towards $115-$125 a barrel.

title: Even as trading and markets moved faster, Warren Buffett made patience profitable and cool
description: Warren Buffett has stepped down from his role as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, marking the end of an era defined by remarkable investment success. Known for his shrewd yet patient approach to bargain-hunting, he outperformed the US stock market time and again. Beyond finance, his down-to-earth advice resonated with countless individuals, earning him a legacy of honesty and trust, inspiring a holistic understanding of success in life.

title: BoJ has room to accelerate rate hikes as inflation pressures build: Report
description: Japan is witnessing a surge in underlying inflation, driven by escalating producer prices and wage growth.
